one_liner: Algorithmic stablecoin on BNB Chain with Chainlink oracles, privacy pools, and cross-chain bridge
project_description:
USDTZ is an advanced algorithmic stablecoin deployed on BNB Chain. It uses Chainlink price oracles for accurate BNB/USD pricing and an automated rebase mechanism to maintain its $1 USD peg. The protocol features a full DeFi ecosystem including:

- Collateral-backed minting and redemption (150% collateral ratio)
- Automated rebase with circuit breaker protection
- StabilizationFund for peg defense through arbitrage
- Cross-chain bridge (ZedxBridge) supporting BNB, Ethereum, and Polygon
- Zero-knowledge privacy pools with Merkle tree verification
- Prediction markets denominated in USDTZ
- Liquidity mining with reward distribution
- Referral system for user growth
- Fiat on-ramp for direct USD entry

All 13 smart contracts are verified on BscScan with full source code transparency.
